snapcast_stream_sample_rate.label: Snapcast stream sample rate
snapcast_stream_sample_rate.description: Maximum PCM sample rate for Music Assistant Snapcast TCP sources. Default is 48000. Higher rates require Snapcast clients that support them.

snapcast_stream_bit_depth.label: Snapcast stream bit depth
snapcast_stream_bit_depth.description: Maximum PCM bit depth for Music Assistant Snapcast TCP sources. Default is 16. 24-bit requires a Snapserver build with packed_s24le TCP ingest support (see snapcast/snapcast#1532).

manifest.description: Synchronize and play music across Snapcast clients (including web browsers and Android devices) on your network.
